body.p: Applicant replies to the Non-Final Rejection dated July 19, 2023, within three months. In the outstanding Office Action, the Examiner rejects claims 1-20.

Applicant thanks the Examiner for her time conducting the Examiner Interview that took place on September 26th. Applicant and the Examiner discussed the rejections under 35 U.S.C. 102. Based on the discussion with the Examiner, Applicant amends presently recited claims, and asserts that the claims as amended overcome the art of record. No exhibits were shown.
The Examiner objects to claim 15 for a minor informality. Applicant amends claim 15 as suggested by the Examiner and asserts the objection is obviated.

The Examiner objects to the drawing for failing to comply with 37 CFR 1.84(p)(5) for failing to include reference signs mentioned in the description, namely Tabs 516 and 616. Applicant amends Figures 5A, 5B, and 6B to include element labels for tabs 516 and 616. Support can be found in the specification as originally filed. Accordingly, Applicant asserts that the objection is obviated.
The Examiner rejects claims 1-10, 13, and 15-17 under 35 U.S.C. 102 as being
anticipated by U.S. Patent No. 7,556,462 (Huber). Applicant respectfully disagrees and traverses the rejection.

Applicant and the Examiner agreed in the Examiner Interview that Huber fails to disclose or contemplate at least "a topskin coupled to the first top mating surface and the second top mating surface of the first tray, the topskin further coupled to the first top mating surface and the second top mating surface of the second tray[,]" as recited in amended independent claim 1, "a topskin coupled to the first top mating surface and the second top mating surface of each tray in the plurality of trays" as recited in amended independent claim 8, and "wherein the plurality of

trays are contiguously covered over an entirety of the plurality of trays," as recited in amended independent claim 15. Applicant further asserts that none of the cited references disclose or contemplate "wherein the first tray and the second tray are disposed below the topskin" (emphasis added) as recited in amended independent claim 1 and similarly recited in amended independent claims 8 and 15. Accordingly, Applicant asserts that the rejection should be withdrawn and the claims are in condition for allowance.

The Examiner rejects claims 11, 12, and 18 under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Huber in view of U.S. Patent No. 6,125,984 (Huber). Claims 11 and 12 various depend from claim 8, and claim 18 depends from claim 15. Applicant asserts that the '984 Huber fails to cure the deficiencies of '462 Huber. Therefore, Applicant asserts the rejection should be withdrawn.

The Examiner rejects claims 14, 19, and 20 under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Huber in view of U.S. Patent Application Publication No. 2017/0313423 (Schoen). Claim 14 depends from independent claim 8, and claims 19 and 20 variously depend from independent claim 15. Applicant asserts that Schoen fails to cure the deficiencies of Huber as outlined above. Accordingly, Applicant asserts that the rejection should be withdrawn.

Applicant adds dependent claim 21, which depends from independent claim 15. Support can be found at least in FIG. 1 and paragraph [0025] as originally filed. Applicant asserts that claim 21 overcomes the cited references at least for the reasons above, in addition to its own unique features.

In view of the foregoing, Applicants respectfully submit that all of the pending claims are allowable over the cited references. Reconsideration of the application is respectfully requested. Should the Examiner wish to discuss any of the above in greater detail or deem that further amendments should be made to improve the form of the claims, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned at the Examiner's convenience. The Commissioner is authorized to charge any fees due to Deposit Account No. 19-28 14, including any required extension fees. This statement does not authorize charge of the Issue Fee.
Gregg Scheiferstein Reg. No. 77,204SNELL & WILMER L.L.P.
